integrity: The proof uses a complete 496-pair finite integer certificate and an explicit 142-bit linear witness. Two standalone checkers independently verify the essential computations. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for all binary palindromes of length nine, with ordinary linear or cyclic factor coverage. No formula for other lengths, count of optimizers, or independent historical-priority finding. The public sequence A330022 had previously displayed 142 explicitly as an upper bound.
title: An exact length-nine binary palindrome superstring: 142 symbols
